'''Aeric Botteger''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident who appears in [[Nynaeve al'Meara]]'s test for the shawl. He may or may not be someone who exists in the real Two Rivers.

==Trivia==
The character is named after reader Eric Boettger.<ref>Brandon Sanderson's Twitter, 3 June 2010. [https://twitter.com/brandsanderson/status/15311005159]</ref>
